topicName: What is PL/SQL and what are its key features?
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"What is PL/SQL and what are its key features?"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"PL/SQL (Procedural Language/SQL) is Oracle's procedural extension to SQL. It combines SQL data manipulation with procedural programming constructs. Key features include block structure, exception handling, stored procedures, triggers, and support for object-oriented programming."}]
